details:
## Status Button:

If it's clickable. make it react and stand out as a button. Is a fundamental UI/UX Design printable.

The new UI changes where things are and separates the "Current Status" (ie Online status and Status Text) from the other buttons making it less easy to identify it as an element you can press. Please give the Status some animation (color change on hover and press) and or make it stand out as an editable place. like a little symbol to edits or make it stand out use slight drop shadows and inlay shadows to make it look like a button. just some suggestions.

## Bio Editing

This isn't even a new complains but it's a good time to bring it up. Editing The "About Me" in VRC, especially when in VR, has been almost unusable for a VERY Long time now. The Text field only shows like 3-4 lines and with missing arrow keys on the VRC VR Keyboard navigating is basically impossible. And it feels like the new Text Editor Field is even Narrower then before. A very usable fix would be to expand the Text Editor Field when you click on it. to see the whole "About Me" Text. And or add Navigation to the Keyboard.

It's nice to have the ability to change the Bio ingame but if navigation fails then that whole system falls apart and no-one will use it.
title: [1878] Status Button and Bio Editing
